Name: Curvy Girl - What you ware under there - Edition.
Author: onlyonechris
Description:
[size=4][color=#ffff00]*1.9 Update!*
﻿Added new ear option "Downward"
﻿Added new underware options, Random and Outfits. If you choose Outfits, when you take off your shirt and/or pants, you will have a matching set of bra and panties or long sleeping tshirt. If you choose Random, you will get a mixed set of bras/panties. Sleeve colors are set for each bra top so you won't get weird arms on different sleeve days when shirtless. [url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8199/8199-1620048284-910539306.png]FYI here.[/url]
﻿Along with the underware options is a workaround for SWIM and how it handles using tools/running while underwater. If you choose underware- "Random, Bra and/or Outfit" when underwater on a SWIM map, instead of seeing unintentional boobs when using a tool, your tata's will be covered by that days underware. 
﻿One more thing about the underware, when Random and/or Outfit is active, if you wear a skimpy shirt, you will see your bra straps or bra depending on how skimpy the shirt is. I like the effect, but if you want to wear a skimpy shirt without seeing the underlaying underware, you'd need to switch to nude or bra for that day. Hope that makes sence.
﻿Removed floor length sleeves from spring and fall random rotation. It is still available to select manually.
﻿Fixed some pants icons in Curvy Girl Pants
﻿Edited the heel shoes to look better when standing forward facing.

Don't forget to check out the clothing packs on the Files page under Optional Files. They are all edited to fit the Curvy Girl sprite!


[/color][color=#f9cb9c]Please Check out the [url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/8199/8199-1616000751-1348362837.png]How To Edit Shoe and Sleeves Random options img[/url] in the pictures section. Until I figure out if it's even possible to disable and enable each option on an individual basis through the Config and still have the Random option this would be how to make your own choices for what shoes and sleeves show up in what seasons. If you're happy with the base options as they are, then you don't have to worry about this.[/color]

[/size]= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =

Curvy Girl does Nine (13) things. 
- Gives female farmer a curvy body
- Optional Fairy Wings or Feather WIngs
- Allows your female mermaid to show her tail!
- Edits to base game pants and shirts to fit the new body
- Allows full nude when removing clothes (Optional)
- Gives your female farmer sleeves that change randomly each day within seasonal options. (Can turn off random and choose sleeves individually)
- Gives your female farmer shoes that change randomly each day within seasonal options. (Can turn off random and choose sleeves individually)
- Gives your farmer the option to have different ear options including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7732] Expressive Elf Ears [/url]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106647918]GoblinHours[/url] with permission. 
- Gives your farmer nose options! noNose, hawk, long, honker, button, buttonchin, vanilla
- Gives your farmer the option for an oval face or vanilla face
- Gives your farmer multiple eye options
- Gives your farmer the option for a more prominent chin

* * *   INSTRUCTIONS   * * *

- Install the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Download this mod, unzip it, and place the '[CP] Curvy Girl" folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
- Run the game once to generate a config.json file.
- Edit the config.json file (Does work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿) with the configuration options you choose. I personally leave it on Random as that is the seasonal options on a random rotation.
